title: Exterior Painting in Lake City, FL | Siding & Stucco
description: Exterior painting in Lake City, FL with acrylic on siding, elastomeric on stucco, rot repair, and a written warranty of up to 10 years. Free walkthroughs.
h1: Exterior Painting in Lake City, FL That Holds Up to Sun and Storms
heroIntro: Lake City siding, stucco, and trim, inspected side by side and painted with a product picked for what each wall is made of. Our exterior workmanship carries written coverage good for as long as 10 years.

sections.h2: Walking a Lake City house elevation by elevation
body: A house rarely wears evenly. Out in Quail Heights or Hidden Acres, the sunny south and west sides of a subdivision house are usually the chalky, faded ones, while the bottom of every wall stays wet from lawn sprinklers and splash-back. Fascia rots where gutters overflow. On older homes near downtown, window sills and porch trim are usually the first to go. As the crew lead circles the house on the walkthrough, each side gets photographed and its own repair list, so a sound wall is never priced like a rotten one.

sections.h2: Siding, stucco, and doors each get their own product
body: Exterior painting in Lake City, FL comes down to fitting the coating to the surface under it. On lap siding, fiber-cement boards, and wood trim we use 100% acrylic, because it keeps flexing as a Columbia County afternoon heats the wall and the evening cools it. Where stucco is moving at fine cracks, an elastomeric finish stretches across them. Front doors and porch railings are finished in waterborne urethane enamel for a harder surface. Not sure whether your stucco cracks are cosmetic? Our article on Lake City stucco cracks explains how to tell. Wider cracks are handled by our stucco repair crews first.

sections.h2: Prep days on a Lake City exterior, in order
bullets: Mildew treatment and a full wash, often a soft wash on painted siding
Loose paint scraped off until the edge holds, glossy patches dulled with sandpaper
Swapping soft trim, sills, and fascia that fail the moisture meter
Fresh caulk in open seams, popped nails driven and set
Primer on any raw wood or new patch
A pair of full finish coats, with sprayed sections worked in by brush or roller
body: Washing is the step that gets skipped most often, and skipping it is why so many paint jobs peel early. We usually pair it with our Lake City pressure washing service so the cleaning and painting crews work from the same plan.

sections.h2: Picking the right months for a Columbia County exterior
body: We like to schedule Lake City exteriors between October and May, the stretch with drier air and fewer thunderstorms rolling up from the Gulf. July and August are not off-limits; the crew just begins at sunrise and checks the dew point and the radar before any paint comes out. On most homes the painting itself fills three to seven working days, and the wash and drying time come on top of that; start dates generally fall one to three weeks after you sign off. For the complete exterior process outside Lake City, see our exterior painting page or return to the Lake City overview.

faqs.q: Which months work best for painting a Lake City exterior?
faqs.a: October through May. When a Lake City job runs into summer, we start the day earlier and keep checking the dew point and radar so the new film gets a chance to cure.

faqs.q: Should my Lake City stucco get elastomeric paint?
faqs.a: If the stucco shows hairline movement, yes. An elastomeric coating stretches over small cracks. Wider cracks get repaired before coating.

faqs.q: How is a Lake City exterior repaint guaranteed?
faqs.a: Our workmanship on the outside of your home is covered in writing for up to 10 years, separate from the paint manufacturer's own product warranty. The estimate tells you exactly which product line we are using.

faqs.q: Do you replace rotted fascia or just paint it?
faqs.a: We replace it. Paint applied over soft wood seals the moisture in, so new fascia and trim boards are priced into the prep line of the estimate.
